I Weighed 150 kg… Then I Was Born Again

By Abdulkarim bin Ibrahim Al-Saab

I weighed 150 kg. There were days when I thought my life was coming to an end. Then God gave me a new beginning. This is the story of what happened in between.

Read the book in Arabic

I write about the fear I felt, my first steps toward change, and adventures I never imagined I would live to see. I hope something in my journey helps you begin your own.

Thank you for reading. If you spot a mistake or a passage gives you pause, please tell me where you found it. This is a human effort, and perfection belongs to God alone. May this book bring useful knowledge and earn His pleasure.
